definition: A source is contaminated if its code, documentation, labels, failure modes, or derived examples were inspected while designing, implementing, debugging, tuning, or explaining AutoContract.

development_sources.name: Albumentations
development_sources.use: H7G development holdout; version 2.0.8 source inspected

development_sources.name: Kornia
development_sources.use: H7H-H8A implementation and replay; version 0.8.3 source inspected

exclusion_rule: No exact symbol, source binding, example, or derived variant in this registry may count as a novel final-blind unit. A sealed final corpus must include at least one framework absent from this registry, and every included release and binding must have been selected after the analyzer freeze.
maintenance_rule: Append every source inspected before the final prediction freeze. Never remove an entry to make a unit eligible.
